results.name: case_01_cache_hit_zero_headers
results.description: Static asset cache hit must have zero X-Proxy-* and X-Cache-* headers on wire

results.name: case_02_dynamic_api_passthrough
results.description: Dynamic API requests pass through upstream with zero local mocks and clean headers

results.name: case_03_heartbeat_passthrough
results.description: Anti-cheat & heartbeat endpoint /ob/r must penetrate upstream without local interference

results.name: case_04_options_preflight
results.description: OPTIONS preflight must return 200 with wildcard CORS headers and standard allowed methods

results.name: case_05_upstream_relay_query
results.description: GBF official portal must be relayed to upstream returning 200, 301, or 302

results.name: case_06_chunked_post
results.description: Chunked Transfer-Encoding POST must be forwarded upstream intact

results.name: case_07_cors_preservation
results.description: Dynamic API responses must strictly preserve original upstream CORS without injecting '*'

results.name: case_08_cache_query_normalization
results.description: Cache lookup strips query parameters, hitting cached asset under cache-busting queries

results.name: case_09_path_traversal_rejection
results.description: Path traversal sequences in asset URLs must be safely rejected and never leak local files

results.name: case_10_head_request_zero_body
results.description: HEAD requests to static assets return 200 with zero content length body and preserved Content-Length header

results.name: case_11_multi_set_cookie_preservation
results.description: Multiple Set-Cookie headers from upstream must be preserved as distinct headers without folding

results.name: case_12_singleflight_coalescing
results.description: Concurrent requests for identical un-cached asset coalesce into 1 upstream fetch via SingleFlight

results.name: case_13_singleflight_failure_recovery
results.description: When a SingleFlight fetch fails, in-flight state is cleared and subsequent requests re-fetch cleanly

results.name: case_14_root_ca_endpoint
results.description: GET /ca.crt serves valid Root CA certificate PEM for client setup

results.name: case_15_dynamic_pac_endpoint
results.description: GET /proxy.pac serves valid PAC script referencing the proxy port

results.name: case_16_mobile_landing_endpoint
results.description: GET / on proxy port serves mobile guide HTML landing page

results.name: case_17_skyleap_mobage_upstream
results.description: SkyLeap Mobage portal request is proxied through without error

results.name: case_18_lan_acl_rejection
results.description: LAN ACL permits loopback client connections and maintains allow_lan=False default

results.name: case_19_offline_cache_fallback
results.description: When upstream returns error, proxy serves cached asset copy as offline fallback

results.name: case_20_post_zero_retry
results.description: POST requests on upstream disconnect MUST NOT retry (strictly max_attempts=1)

results.name: case_21_get_safe_retry_whitelist
results.description: Non-whitelisted GET drops without retry; whitelisted GET allows 1 silent fast retry

results.name: case_22_connection_reuse_keepalive
results.description: Client reuse of persistent HTTP keep-alive connection across multiple requests

results.name: case_23_asset_byte_fidelity
results.description: Static assets served from proxy must be 100% byte-for-byte identical to upstream bytes

results.name: case_24_offline_cache_independence
results.description: Once cached, static assets can be retrieved offline when upstream is unreachable

results.description: Dynamic game API requests are never persisted into static asset cache
